description: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP (up to 10 MB) and get a public https://img.apiko.app URL for reference fields such as images, first_image_url or reference_image_urls. Free (per key: 60 per minute, 1,000 per day). Give exactly one of path (a local file the user named) or url. The uploaded copy is public to anyone with the link and deleted after 72 hours, so only upload files the user asked to use.

path.description: Local file path (absolute, ~/..., or relative to the server's working directory).

url.description: Public http(s) image URL to copy.

name: upload_image
title: Upload a reference image
